adjudication.rationale: The new webhook handler does `findFirst({ where: { userId, appId }})` and then conditionally `credential.create(...)` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts around lines 55-86). That check-then-act sequence is not atomic, so concurrent webhook requests could both observe “no credential” and attempt to create. Whether this results in actual duplicate rows vs. a DB constraint error depends on schema/unique indexes, which are not shown in the diff, so the finding’s “will create duplicates” outcome isn’t fully verifiable from this PR alone.
